hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq '"kind"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(StatefulSet|PersistentVolumeClaim)"' && { echo 'Deleting a StatefulSet or a PersistentVolumeClaim destroys data the backup does not carry. Ask the user to confirm it in their own words and run it themselves.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq '"replicas"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*0([^0-9]|$)' && { echo 'Scaling to zero stops the workload. Say what it would stop and let the user ask for it, rather than doing it on your own initiative.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
